final: SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(profile_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct) AS profile_avg FROM telescopes AS t2 JOIN observatories AS o2 ON o2.observstation = t2.observstation WHERE t2.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o2.weathprofile)) AS difference_from_profile_mean FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile HAVING (SELECT AVG(profile_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct) AS profile_avg FROM telescopes AS t2 JOIN observatories AS o2 ON o2.observstation = t2.observstation WHERE t2.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o2.weathprofile)) IS NOT NULL
